## Use OpenDyslexic Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set OpenDyslexic Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'OpenDyslexic Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the OpenDyslexic Mono coding font

A font designed specifically for people with dyslexia. OpenDyslexic Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

OpenDyslexic Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## OpenDyslexic Mono FAQ

### Is OpenDyslexic Mono free?

Yes. OpenDyslexic Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does OpenDyslexic Mono support ligatures?

No. OpenDyslexic Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get OpenDyslexic Mono?

OpenDyslexic Mono is available from Official Website and GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
